name: The Library of Falling Leaves and Floating Books
description: An ancient, majestic library hall where books float gently in the air alongside golden autumn leaves drifting upwards towards a sunlit dome.
prompt: A majestic, ancient library hall with high arched ceilings and towering bookshelves. Golden autumn leaves float upwards into the air, mingling with open, glowing books that flutter like birds. Warm, golden sunlight streams through tall stained-glass windows, illuminating floating dust motes and creating a magical, nostalgic atmosphere. Highly detailed, whimsical, fantasy art.
caption: Where knowledge rises like autumn leaves, and stories float in the warm sunlight. 📚✨
